mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as the philosophical study of beauty and taste."
Aesthetics may be defined as the philosophical study of beauty and taste.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a member of a society and he takes his material from the society."
A writer is a member of a society and he takes his material from the society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a counter-hegemony discourse against patriarchy in order to create space for women in the male-centred world."
Feminism is a counter-hegemony discourse against patriarchy in order to create space for women in the male-centred world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a masquerader who performs in the evening and satirically attacks anti- social attitudes in the society."
The etiyeri is a masquerader who performs in the evening and satirically attacks anti- social attitudes in the society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bad reaper: it plucks the unripe fruits first; "plunder" evokes the ravage that has taken place."
Death is a bad reaper: it plucks the unripe fruits first; "plunder" evokes the ravage that has taken place.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to further prove the truth in the words of the poet As with the proverb, the poet also uses the pronoun in a manner characteristic of a traditional African singer."
Proverbs in the poems are used to further prove the truth in the words of the poet As with the proverb, the poet also uses the pronoun in a manner characteristic of a traditional African singer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a stylistic virtue; that 'brevity is the soul of wit'-and so on."
economy is a stylistic virtue; that 'brevity is the soul of wit'-and so on.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a type of criticism that can include discussion of society, of social relationship and of historical issues."
Sociological criticism is a type of criticism that can include discussion of society, of social relationship and of historical issues.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integral aspect of the oral tradition."
Proverbs is an integral aspect of the oral tradition.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most persistent notes in African poetry in particular and literature in general."
The theme of colonialism is one of the most persistent notes in African poetry in particular and literature in general.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an aspect of African traditional oral culture."
Celebration in poetry is an aspect of African traditional oral culture.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the oldest and most prominent persons associated with African poetry and the exposition of African culture."
Senghor is one of the oldest and most prominent persons associated with African poetry and the exposition of African culture.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known for his deployment of devices from his Yoruba root into his poetry in English."
Osundare is known for his deployment of devices from his Yoruba root into his poetry in English.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the dominant colour in Idanre, showing Soyinka's abiding interest in that transitional period between life and dissolution."
Grey is the dominant colour in Idanre, showing Soyinka's abiding interest in that transitional period between life and dissolution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of Ghana's new generation poets."
Kofi Anyidoho is one of Ghana's new generation poets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an exception to the typical African intellectual whom Chinua Achebe describes as reading a few uninspiring British novels (61-66)."
Soyinka is an exception to the typical African intellectual whom Chinua Achebe describes as reading a few uninspiring British novels (61-66).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the black South Africa's most talented poets."
Mitshali is one of the black South Africa's most talented poets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a victim of historical determinism."
The African is a victim of historical determinism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a living and dynamic verbal art."
Yoruba oral poetry is a living and dynamic verbal art.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the issue of colour and contain emotionally charged words, which are signs of tension, inferiority complex, the myth of racial superiority and protest."
Williams's poems constantly refer to the issue of colour and contain emotionally charged words, which are signs of tension, inferiority complex, the myth of racial superiority and protest.
